about: Default portraits (dungeon/art.py stock_portrait): stock pictures of common kinds of people, shown on the stage for someone met who has no portrait of their own. Made once with scripts/art/portraits.py; the images are assets/portraits/<id>.webp (600x800). A portrait is picked by the person's folk, then the words of their job (`roles`), their pronouns and their age (`age`: young under 30, middle under 55, old), else a `default` one; people who match the same entries are spread across them by key.
portrait_style: Painterly digital fantasy portrait with the crisp, saturated finish of a full-dive video game world, dramatic light, head and shoulders, three-quarter view, a softly blurred stone-and-lantern background
portrait_avoid: text, lettering, user interface, health bars, watermark, logo, signature, frame, border, a second person

portraits.prompt: A tower-town innkeeper in his forties, bull-necked and bald with a braided black beard, a leather apron over a red wool shirt, a ring of iron keys at his belt, a broad untrustworthy grin.
An alehouse keeper in her forties with a handsome hard face, copper hair coiled and pinned with a skewer, a laced leather bodice over a cream shirt, a tankard in hand, sizing up a newcomer.
A serving girl of about twenty in a tower tavern, dark skin and close-cropped hair, a brass ring in one ear, a plain linen dress with an apron, quick wary eyes.
A porter of about twenty, wiry and sun-starved pale, a shock of black hair, a rope coil over one shoulder, a patched blue tunic and a leather carrying harness.
A Wall soldier in his thirties, a scarred square face, a dented open-faced steel helm, a mail shirt under a grey surcoat with a stitched tower badge, a spear haft against his shoulder.
A gate warden in her late twenties, a lean hard face with a burn scar along the jaw, sandy hair in a tight warrior's braid, a steel gorget and a grey surcoat, a crossbow strap across her chest.

A veteran Wall captain in his fifties, a craggy grey-bearded face with one milky eye, a battered breastplate etched with tally marks, a heavy fur-lined cloak, the look of a man who has buried many recruits.
A warden captain in her forties, iron-grey hair shaved at the sides, a stern weathered face, scaled armour under a long grey cloak, a captain's chain at her throat.
A tower mason in his forties, stone dust in his beard and eyebrows, a heavy brow, a leather cap, a sleeveless work tunic baring thick scarred arms, a chisel behind one ear.
A stoneworker in her thirties, broad-shouldered, a dusty kerchief over dark hair, a strong plain face with a crooked nose, a heavy canvas apron with tools hanging from it.

A tower climber in his twenties, a modern Earth face among fantasy gear: an undercut haircut, a few days' stubble, a scuffed leather brigandine over a padded jacket, climbing rope and pitons on his harness, a short sword at his shoulder.

A tower climber in her twenties with an Earth-born look in fantasy gear: a dark ponytail through a scuffed leather cap, a nose ring, a fitted brigandine over a hooded travel cloak, a coil of rope and a long knife at her shoulder.

A grizzled old climber in his fifties who came from Earth long ago: a deeply tanned scarred face, a grey ponytail, faded tattoos on his neck, patched chain mail over a quilted coat, a thousand-yard stare.
A tower church sexton in his sixties, a gaunt shaven face, tonsured grey hair, a plain ash-grey habit with a rope belt, a small iron pair of scales on a cord at his neck.

A vowed sister in her twenties, a pale serene face with a faint glow of light under the skin along her collarbones, hair hidden under a grey veil, an ash-grey habit and a small iron pair of scales at her throat.
A tower-market trader in his forties, olive skin and a hooked nose, a waxed black mustache, a brocade vest over a loose white shirt, gold rings, a salesman's warm smile and cold eyes.
A spice trader in her forties, deep brown skin, a bright patterned head wrap, kohl-rimmed eyes, layered copper necklaces, a quick, shrewd look.
A tower lord in his fifties, a lean hawkish face, a neat silver beard, a high-collared black velvet doublet with silver embroidery, a heavy signet ring, an icy, assessing gaze.
A noblewoman of a tower keep in her forties, a pale composed face, dark hair in an elaborate braided crown, a deep crimson gown with a high collar, pearl earrings, a faint cruel smile.
A back-alley fence in his thirties, a narrow pockmarked face, slicked-back hair, a gold tooth, a dark hooded coat over a stolen silk shirt, a smile like a knife.
A room-broker and salon keeper in her forties, striking and heavily made up, black hair swept to one side, a low-cut emerald gown with a fur stole, many rings, a knowing, transactional look.
A salon courtesan in her mid twenties, kohl-lined eyes, rouged lips, loose dark curls with gold pins, a silk wrap off one shoulder, a tired, calculating gaze under the practiced warmth.
A wharf hand in his forties, a broad sunburnt face, a braided beard with a bead in it, a sweat-stained sleeveless shirt, a hook at his belt and rope burns on his hands.
A miller's widow in her fifties, a flour-dusted lined face, grey hair under a black kerchief, a worn black dress with the sleeves pushed up, a grief that has hardened into stubbornness.
A guild clerk, a grown man of about twenty-eight, with a long pale face, round wire spectacles, a neat dark coat with a brass guild badge, a fussy, precise look.
A floor guide in her twenties, a freckled clever face, red hair cropped short, a fitted blue travel coat with many pockets, a brass lantern hooked at her shoulder.

A Seraph of the Lit: ash-gray feathered wings folded behind the shoulders, a dim halo of light above the head, pale fire burning in the pupils, a stern ageless face, an ash-grey vestment with silver scales embroidered at the collar.
A Delver: a short, enormously dense and broad person with a mineral, slate-like sheen to the skin, a heavy brow, small deep-set eyes, coarse dark hair, a plain leather jerkin over massive shoulders.
A Therian woman in her twenties marked by the fox line: tall russet fox ears among her red hair, faintly longer canines in a sly smile, amber eyes, a short green cloak.
A Therian man in his twenties marked by the wolf line: grey wolf ears in shaggy dark hair, longer canines, yellow-grey eyes, a scarred jaw, a leather vest over a bare chest.
A young tower native in his twenties, a lean hungry face, dark tousled hair, a patched brown hooded tunic, a cord bracelet, wary eyes.
A young tower native in her twenties, a heart-shaped face, long black hair in two braids, a faded rust-red dress with a leather belt pouch, a guarded curious look.
A tower townsman in his forties, a heavy-browed weathered face, a grey-shot brown beard, a quilted coat, the stillness of someone used to bad news.
A tower townswoman in her forties, a strong-jawed face with crow's feet, dark hair under a woven head scarf, a brown wool dress and shawl, a sceptical look.
An old tower native in his seventies, a skull-thin face with a white braided beard, milky blue eyes, a threadbare grey cloak.
An old tower native in her seventies, a crinkled brown face, silver hair in a tight crown of braids, many beads at her throat, sharp knowing eyes.
